integrity: Complete proof of the new universal threshold and explicit periodic witness; standard-library finite checker is auxiliary and does not certify infinite-time dynamics. Independent review has not been performed.
limitations: Universal exclusion is sufficient but not necessary for individual payoffs; existence above threshold is established for the explicit family, not all parameters. Neither uniqueness nor orbital attraction of individual cycles is asserted. Deterministic homogeneous continuous-time system only.
title: A sharp universal logit-slope barrier for epidemic oscillations, with periodic SIS witnesses
